run_pybullet_sleeping_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation that loads multiple R2D2 robots and demonstrates physics sleeping behavior
load_urdf_with_sleeping_flag: load a URDF robot model into pybullet with the URDF_ENABLE_SLEEPING flag enabled
set_joint_velocity_control: set joint motor control to velocity control mode with zero target velocity on all joints
change_dynamics_activation_state: change the dynamics activation state of a body to force it to wake up from sleeping
step_simulation_in_loop: step the pybullet physics simulation in a loop while the GUI connection is active
